stock.description: DIT Group Limited, together with its various subsidiaries, primarily operates in China, where it specializes in prefabricated construction projects. The company's diverse portfolio also encompasses services such as interior decoration, landscaping, and consulting, alongside equipment sales and licensing activities. Furthermore, DIT Group actively participates in commercial property investments, particularly within Shandong province, and undertakes property development initiatives. Established in 1991, the company officially changed its name to DIT Group Limited in November 2019, having previously been known as China Minsheng DIT Group Limited. Its corporate headquarters are located in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
